items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: I let them go several times on account of drinking so hard. And blowing up a job right there in Biloxi. He dropped around out of the truck, so he got Saeed, sent it back to New York.

ctx.x: Chinese, is that something about Chinese?

Chinese, they were all sorts. I let them go several times on account of drinking so hard. And blowing up a job right there in Biloxi. He dropped around out of the truck, so he got Saeed, sent it back to New York.
He said he'd entice you to come in the band, Shani, huh?
